source_evidence: Investment advisers offer a wide range of products and services, including financial planning, portfolio management or even advice concerning the selection of other investment advisers.
question: Misconception: All investment advisers provide the same services, so there is no need to discuss what kind of help you want before opening an account.
answer: Advisers can offer different services, so discuss what you want from the account and check that a potential adviser can provide services that fit your needs. You can also clarify your preferred level of contact, monitoring, and decision-making authority.
